sentences.text: 1. The petitioner - Shareefa Begum W/o Gulam Hussain Butt R/o Hullar, Lachdayaram, District Kishtwar submits that she is an owner in possession of land comprised in khasra Nos. 310 min (10 marlas) & 388 min (6.18 kanal) in village Lachdayaram and to this fact statement refers to khasra- girdawari of the year 2025 annexed with the writ petition.

2. The cause of action for the petitioner to come forward with the present writ petition is relatable to an ongoing construction of link road 'Hullar - Hunjala' (2nd phase) in Village Lachdayaram,
Kishtwar which is being undertaken by Public Works Department (R&B), Division Kishtwar with respect to which in January, 2007 land acquisition exercise under the Jammu & Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 is said to have been put into effect in which connection even the petitioner's land comprised in khasra No. 342(1) measuring 1 kanal 1 marla is said to have been Shareefa Begum vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82413365/
1 acquired against payment of compensation through private negotiations duly received by the petitioner.
3.

entities.text: Shareefa Begum vs Ut Of J&K & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The petitioner has come to be confronted with a situation that said proposed road in terms of its originally approved alignment is being diverted to pass through the petitioner's land in khasra Nos.
310 min and 338 min by abandoning the regular alignment which is meant to pass only through the acquired khasra numbers.

4. The petitioner submits that the diversion is being instigated by one Nishat Ahmed, whose land in khasra no. 342 also came to be acquired but in order to salvage his acquired land in said khasra No.
342, by hobnobbing with on site officials of PWD (R&B) is getting the diversion of the alignment of the road.

5. In para 9 of the writ petition, the petitioner comes up with an averment and allegation that the agency engaged by the respondents for construction of subject road are not adhering to settled and approved alignment and instead are resorting to a different alignment contrary to the approved alignment and in that process exposing the land of the petitioner in aforesaid two khasra numbers to damage.

6. Thus, the petitioner is seeking issuance of writ of mandamus unto the writ respondents to strictly adhere and follow the approved DPR and site alignment viz alignment of the link road PMGSY 'Hullar - Hunjala' (2nd phase) in Village Lachdayaram, Kishtwar and host of other reliefs.

7. The petitioner submits that there are fruit growing trees and a residential house obtaining upon her land located in khasra No. 310 min.
8.

9. Issue notice to the respondents in the main petition as well as in connected CM.
10.
Ms. Pallavi Sharma, Advocate appearing vice Mr. Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG accepts notice on behalf of the respondents.
Objections be filed before the next date of hearing.

11. In the meantime, the respondent No. 3 - Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Kishtwar and the respondent No. 4 - Chief Engineer, PWD (R&B) Department, Jammu are directed to maintain the construction work of the link road PMGSY 'Hullar - Hunjala' (2nd phase) in Village Lachdayaram, Kishtwar as per the approved DPR and site plan and in case if the original DPR and site plan does not involve alignment of the road through khasra Nos. 310 & 338 then not to appropriate any land of the petitioner from khasra Nos. 310 & 338 without first adopting due course of law.
12.

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Kishtwar
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: This order is, however, subject to objections from the other side.

13. List on 07.02.2026.
